creator.description: Address of the creator of the task

scheduled_timestamp.description: Unix timestamp when the task is scheduled to execute Can be either a Unix timestamp or a time offset prefixed with "+" (e.g. "+1h30m") Offset is relative to the current block time

expiry_timestamp.description: Unix timestamp after which the task will expire if not executed Can be either a Unix timestamp or a time offset prefixed with "+" (e.g. "+2h") When using an offset, it's relative to the scheduled_timestamp

task_gas_limit.description: Maximum gas limit for the task execution

task_gas_fee.description: Gas fee for the task execution

type_url.description: The type url prefixed with a slash, like '/cosmos.bank.v1beta1.MsgSend'

value.description: Must be a valid serialized protocol buffer of the above specified type.

items.title: Any
items.description: Contains the serialized protocol buffer message using the response bytes from `/dysonprotocol.script.v1.QueryEncodeJsonRequest`

msgs.description: Messages to execute as part of the task
